incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU pool 'infer-prod-1' utilization >95% for 6m, request queue growth detected (6k pending). Autoscaler alerts: failed to scale (retries exhausted). Paging Carmen

Carmen: I'm on it. Thanks for the page. Can someone drop recent autoscaler logs and any recent deploys?

Alice: saw the page. Pulling autoscaler controller logs now.

Ben: I can check cloud quota side. Last quota change was last week for project-redwood-prod.

Alice: logs show repeated errors: 
```
E0321 15:45:22 scaler.go:312] scale up error: AllocateGPUs: rpc error: code=ResourceExhausted desc=quota exceeded for region us-west1: GPUs v2 request denied
E0321 15:46:05 scaler.go:312] scale up error: AllocateGPUs: rpc error: code=ResourceExhausted desc=quota exceeded for region us-west1: GPUs v2 request denied
```
Looks like autoscaler is attempting but cloud is rejecting.

Ben: Confirmed. Quota (v2 GPUs) at 100% for us-west1. There was a service request yesterday for extra quota but it wasn't approved.

Dinesh: That would explain retries. Autoscaler backoff is exponential, so it's stuck in retry loop and not reallocating other pools. We should open temporary overflow to infer-prod-2 (secondary pool in us-east1) and enable cross-region fallback in routing.

Carmen: Agreed. Alice, can you trigger manual scale on infer-prod-1 to see if any fractional increases succeed? If cloud rejects everything, switch to fallback pool.

Alice: Running manual scale command now: `robin pool scale infer-prod-1 --replicas 12 --force`

deploy-bot: Deploy notice: autoscaler policy update merged by Alice at 1927004200 (PR #4021). Rolling config applied to 3 clusters.

Alice: Manual scale returned errors identical to logs: `quota exceeded`. No luck.

Ben: I'm escalating quota with cloud support, but that's not quick. We need an immediate mitigation that doesn't need more GPUs in us-west1. Options: 1) route new requests to quantized/cheaper model variant on existing nodes, 2) enable overflow to us-east1, 3) enable temporary throttling for non-SLAs.

Carmen: Which customers are impacted? Any high-SLA traffic?

Alice: From traces: 12 customers seeing 5-10s tail latency increases, error rate up ~2% due to request timeouts. Traffic trace shows a sudden spike from one customer campaign (internal id: cust-774).

Ben: I can create a traffic diversion rule: route 30% of new requests to infer-prod-2 (us-east1) which has spare capacity. This will increase cross-region egress, but better than timeouts.

Dinesh: Also suggest switching low-priority routes to the q4-small quantized model we validated last quarter. Lower accuracy but keeps requests served. We should announce this as a graceful degradation.

Carmen: Do both. Ben: proceed with diversion. Dinesh: flip non-SLA routes to quantized variant. Alice: coordinate with SRE to watch KV caches and latencies.

Ben: Pushing diversion: `routerctl create-route --from infer-prod --to infer-prod-2 --percent 30 --reason "overflow"`

sre-rotation: Monitoring net egress and latency. Watch for cache miss spike across regions.

incident-bot: NOTE: Created incident channel #inc-1927004321 for full incident coordination.

Alice: Diversion in place. Traffic to us-east1 ramping to 30%. Seeing immediate drop in queue depth from 6k to 2.1k.

Dinesh: Flipping non-SLA routes to q4-small now. `modelctl set-variant --route non-sla --model q4-small --ratio 100`

Carmen: Good. Any sign of regressions?

sre-rotation: Latency for SLA routes returning to baseline. Non-SLA routes show slightly degraded output quality (per eval hooks) but latency stable. Queue now 800.

Ben: Cloud support responded: temporary quota increase request DENIED (manual review). They provided an estimated lead time of 3–5 days for approval.

Carmen: Not acceptable for immediate resolution. Plan for mid-term: request quota increase + increase pool capacity via reserved Dedicated capacity purchase. Short-term: keep diversion + quantized fallback + throttling for low-priority.

Alice: Also found that autoscaler policy change merged earlier reduced maxBurst from 20->8 (PR #4021). That limited ability to absorb spikes. Rolling back that change might have helped.

Carmen: Who merged the policy?

deploy-bot: PR #4021 merged by Alice. Diff snippet: `maxBurst: 20 -> 8`

Alice: I will roll back that patch and redeploy the autoscaler config to restore maxBurst to 20. Doing canary redeploy to one cluster first.

Dinesh: Recommend adding a guard to PRs that touch autoscaling limits — require SRE signoff and load-test evidence.

Carmen: Agreed. Action item.

sre-rotation: After diversions and model fallback: queue stabilized under 300 and throttle events stopped. Taking this to monitoring-only state.

Carmen: Handing off to Eva for 08:00–16:00 shift. Eva, can you own follow-up and the post-incident cleanup?

Eva: Taking over. I'll gather logs, open the follow-up ticket, and start the postmortem doc.

Carmen: Immediate mitigation notes for postmortem: 1) Re-enable maxBurst=20, 2) Add cross-region overflow as an automatic fallback when local quota errors seen, 3) Add a quota-exceeded alert that pages at 80% of quota, not just infra utilization, 4) Add SRE signoff gate for autoscaler config changes, 5) Evaluate Dedicated reserved capacity for critical pools.

Eva: I'll create incident task list and assign owners. Drafting postmortem now.

Alice: Rolling back PR and will redeploy in canary. Notifying deploy-bot for rollback verification.

deploy-bot: Rollback started for autoscaler-policy (PR #4021-revert). Canary applied to cluster-3 at 1927004820.

sre-rotation: Canary looks healthy. No immediate degradation. Can run full rollout after Eva confirms.

Eva: Full list of follow-up tickets I will open in the incident board: 
- INC-1927004321-1: Revert autoscaler maxBurst change + test (owner: Alice)
- INC-1927004321-2: Cross-region overflow automation (owner: Dinesh)
- INC-1927004321-3: Quota-alerting + playbook (owner: Ben)
- INC-1927004321-4: Purchase/plan Dedicated capacity for infer-prod pools (owner: Carmen)
- INC-1927004321-5: PR gate policy for autoscaler config changes (owner: SRE team)

Carmen: Thanks team. Closing active mitigation. Keep thread for postmortem drafts and customer comms. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Start postmortem in 24h if no regressions.
